gcp.kms.operation.note: Cryptographic operations (encrypt, decrypt, sign, MAC, random bytes); HSM RSA 3072/4096 and elliptic curve keys cost more. Admin operations are free. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.kms.version.note: Active key version (enabled, disabled or scheduled for destruction) by protection level: software, HSM symmetric and RSA 2048, HSM RSA 3072/4096 and elliptic curve (first 2,000 a month), external. The same in every region. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.
